message.reasoning:
We need to fix compilation errors.

Errors:

1. org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension not found. Probably we don't need MockitoExtension for this test. Remove import and @ExtendWith annotation.

2. URIFactory abstract method create(URI,String) not overridden. The URIFactory interface likely has method create(URI uri, String something) maybe create(URI uri) overloaded? Need to implement both methods. Let's inspect typical URIFactory interface in networknt schema library. I recall URIFactory has method URI create(String uri) and maybe URI create(URI base, String reference). Let's search memory: In networknt json-schema-validator, there is interface URIFactory with method URI create(String uri); and default method URI create(URI base, String reference) maybe? Not sure. The error says abstract method create(URI,String). So URIFactory has method create(URI base, String reference). Our anonymous class only implements create(String). Must implement both.

Implement both methods delegating to URI.create.

Similarly for customFactory.

Thus modify expectedUriFactory and customFactory definitions to implement both methods.

Also need import for URI already present.

Also builder().uriFactory(customFactory) method may exist. Keep.

Remove MockitoExtension import and annotation.

Let's produce corrected code.
